title: Kitten reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x='30' y='62' width='40' height='24' rx='3' fill='#3d7dd6'/>
  <rect x='30' y='62' width='40' height='6' rx='3' fill='#6aa5f0'/>
  <rect x='33' y='70' width='15' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#f4f0e0'/>
  <rect x='52' y='70' width='15' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#f4f0e0'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='68' x2='50' y2='86' stroke='#6aa5f0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='74' x2='45' y2='74' stroke='#c9b98a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='78' x2='45' y2='78' stroke='#c9b98a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='74' x2='64' y2='74' stroke='#c9b98a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='78' x2='64' y2='78' stroke='#c9b98a' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='17' ry='13' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#ffd9a8'/>

  <!-- paws on book -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='68' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='68' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='67' r='1.2' fill='#ffd9a8'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='67' r='1.2' fill='#ffd9a8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='67' r='1.2' fill='#ffd9a8'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='67' r='1.2' fill='#ffd9a8'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='19' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='35,30 33,12 47,24' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <polygon points='65,30 67,12 53,24' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <polygon points='38,28 37,17 45,25' fill='#ffb6c1'/>
  <polygon points='62,28 63,17 55,25' fill='#ffb6c1'/>

  <!-- eyes looking down at book -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='44' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#2e7d5b'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='44' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#2e7d5b'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='45.5' r='2' fill='#123d2c'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='45.5' r='2' fill='#123d2c'/>
  <circle cx='44.2' cy='43.5' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58.2' cy='43.5' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- nose and mouth -->
  <polygon points='48,51 52,51 50,53.5' fill='#ffb6c1'/>
  <path d='M44 56 Q47 58 50 55 Q53 58 56 56' stroke='#d97b3a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='28' y1='48' x2='38' y2='50' stroke='#ffd9a8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='53' x2='38' y2='53' stroke='#ffd9a8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='48' x2='62' y2='50' stroke='#ffd9a8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='53' x2='62' y2='53' stroke='#ffd9a8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M67 80 Q80 82 78 68 Q77 62 72 63' stroke='#f2a65a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
